Kate Laister-Smith

"Working with Warwick Institute of Engagement has completely changed the course of my future.”

Kate Laister-Smith discusses how the flexibility of her degree, the practical aspects of her education, and her time as a Student Director of the Warwick Institute of Engagement (WIE) shaped her public engagement career ambitions as an undergraduate at the university.
